name: Oshioki Sweetie ~Koi Suru Onee-san wa Urahara Desu~
original_name: オシオキSweetie～恋するお姉さんはウラハラです～
source:
Three girls form an unofficial cosplay club at school. Kazuto gets invited to a villa on a solitary island. To his surprise he is greeted by three cosplay club members in maid clothes who speak very polite language. And they are very eager to serve their new master as diligently as possible.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三名少女在学校里组成了一个非正式角色扮演社团。一人受邀前往孤岛上的别墅，惊讶地发现三名社团成员穿着女仆装前来迎接，还使用格外恭敬的措辞。她们都迫不及待地想尽心尽力服侍自己的新主人。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
